_meta.description: Start a conversation in the CURRENTLY OPEN project and ask Claude to write a song from a description, formatted for extraction (TITLE/STYLE/LYRICS). Waits until the turn is fully complete. Run after open-project or create-project (no navigate — operates on the active project page).

content.description: Description of the song and/or style, e.g. 'a hopeful synthwave anthem about shipping code at dawn'

notes.completion: Completion is detected via the response container's data-is-streaming attribute flipping to 'false' (Stop button also disappears). This is reliable for a fresh one-shot conversation.
notes.send: Submit is a click on button[aria-label='Send message'] — pressing Enter via automation does NOT submit the ProseMirror input.

_meta.risk: starts a chat + uses model usage
_meta.verified: 2026-06-18 — full flow verified on the relay path

chain.value: Write an original song based on this description: {{content}}. Format your entire reply EXACTLY as three parts and nothing else: a line 'TITLE: <a short song title>', then a line 'STYLE: <comma-separated style/genre tags suitable for a music generator>', then a line 'LYRICS:' followed by the full lyrics using [Verse] and [Chorus] section tags.
